about: The single source of the scene surfaces: sets (texture files), photos (single pictures a project can name), patch presets, the material of every rendered objectKind and library role, and the shared lighting. Both editors, the Omniverse bridge and the Kit-native path read this file; tools/gen_pbr_textures.py writes only the measured fields and the generated sets.
colorRules: A material whose `tintable` is false shows `baseColor` times its colour map: the map carries the hue.

A tintable material shows `baseColor` unless the mesh carries an AUTHORED colour: a patch overlay (keepUserColor), or, for `colorSource: model`, any colour that is not one of the renderer defaults in `factoryColors`.
A bound roughness map holds absolute roughness, so the scalar is `roughness / sets[set].stats.meanRoughness` (clamped to 1); without the map it is `roughness`.
A role entry (`role`) is drawn with that library material; `hueInMap` keeps the map colour and ignores the model colour.
`uv`: physical tiles one map per `tileM` metres of the metre-valued UVs; stretch fits one map to the face; tile-per-u fits one map per rack unit.
